round_count_unit: partial rounds (plus eight fixed full rounds)
message_domain: Exactly two canonical Pallas field elements nk,rho encoded as 32 little-endian bytes each. Each integer must be less than p; aliases reduced modulo p are rejected.
round_selection: Original full rounds 0..3, original partial rounds 4..33 (empty when r=0), original full rounds 60..63. Constants and MDS pinned to deployed halo2_poseidon 0.2.0; never regenerate constants for reduced r.
initialization: [nk, rho, 2^65]. This is ConstantLength<2>, not raw permutation collision and not the complete Orchard nullifier.
schedule: Add constants, x^5 on all three coordinates in full rounds or coordinate zero in partial rounds, then dense deployed MDS over Pallas.
digest_encoding: Final coordinate zero, canonical 32-byte little-endian Pallas encoding. Compare the entire element.

relation.postcondition: The selected-round Orchard hashes are equal in Pallas.

out_of_scope: Changing constants, MDS, exponent or output
